provenance_laws: appcompat 1.4.2 (META-INF/androidx.appcompat_appcompat.version=1.4.2 in the memory APK; sources.jar fetched from maven.google.com and read): attachBaseContext2 wraps the activity in androidx.appcompat.view.ContextThemeWrapper(R.style.Theme_AppCompat_Empty) whose initializeTheme CLONES the base activity theme via Theme.setTo and applies the Empty style (theme.applyStyle(resid, force=true)); the source comment states 'calling getTheme() will clone the base context's theme into the wrapped context's theme'

Theme.AppCompat.Empty is a SIZE-0 PARENTLESS style (aapt2 dump of the memory arsc: 'style/Theme.AppCompat.Empty ... size=0' with no parent) — it contributes NO attrs; the CONT-67 'Empty carries the AppCompatTheme defaults' premise is DISPROVEN

SplashActivity (both apps) extends AppCompatActivity and its onCreate is startActivity+finish ONLY (disassembled: no setContentView); AOSP ActivityThread.handleStartActivity has `if (r.activity.mFinished) return;` at the top (fetched source), so on a device onPostCreate NEVER runs for the splash and the theme guard is never reached
onPostCreate dispatches ensureSubDecor (appcompat 1.4.2 AppCompatDelegateImpl.onPostCreate) — the only pre-setContentView path to the guard

createSubDecor tail (1.4.2 source L986-1000): migrates window-content children into the subdecor's ContentFrameLayout through Window.findViewById(android.R.id.content), then windowContentView.setId(NO_ID) + contentView.setId(android.R.id.content)
